card.name: Scattered mid-sentence words, endosulfan
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on unrelated words such as 'ulf' inside endosulfan, 'of' after coadministration, and 'venom' or 'program' after 'the'.

modes.label: Inside endosulfan

modes.label: Words before a noun phrase
modes.description: Linking or ordinary words in mid-clause, such as 'of' after coadministration or 'ing' in 'infecting'.
